subject: Leveling recommendation + comp bands for Jordan Lee (L5 vs L6)
messages:
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: alex_martinez@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Candidate: Jordan Lee — initial leveling and comp ask

Hi Markus —

Jordan (ex-GrowthAI, previously Senior ML Engineer) finished on-site last week. He asked for clarity on level and comp before we send an official offer. Recruiter/KEP indicated a target base of $220k and 20% target bonus. Internal comps spreadsheet attached (20260218_offer_comps.xlsx).

Key points:
- Strong system design + shipping roadmap for inference optimizations.
- Has IC leadership and led cross-team infra pieces (no direct reports).
- Interview feedback: majority scored at the top of our L5 rubric; two interviewers suggested L6 for impact/scale.

Question: Do we position as L5 (Senior, with a higher comp/stock band) or L6 (Staff) for this hire? Hiring manager (Alex) is looped — his preference matters for title and future org chart. If L6, we should confirm approved headcount for Staff level and sign-off for comp above midpoint.

Proposed offer (pending sign-off):
- Option A (L5 Senior Engineer): base 220k, 20% bonus, 30k equity grant (4y)
- Option B (L6 Staff Engineer): base 240k, 25% bonus, 60k equity grant (4y)

Can you weigh in on leveling and whether we have flexibility on the L6 comp above? I can hold the verbal until we confirm.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: alex_martinez@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 13:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Candidate: Jordan Lee — initial leveling and comp ask

Lauren —

Short answer: lean L6. Long answer: Jordan demonstrated cross-cutting impact in the on-site — the production-readiness approach, ownership of latency regressions at GrowthAI, and the architectural proposal for persistent KV caching are exactly the problems we need at Staff level on the Inference Runtime team. He hasn't managed direct reports, but Staff is commonly used for high-impact ICs here.

Constraints:
- Headcount: we have 1 open Staff slot for the FY (requisition R-2026-413) but it requires EVP/People approval for comp above band midpoint.
- Compensation guidelines: L6 band midpoint currently $225k base; above-midpoint offers require approval by Evelyn (cc'd).

If Evelyn approves, I support Option B. If not, I'd accept an elevated L5 with aggressive equity and a clear written promotion path after 9-12 months if he hits the milestones (owner of cache project, cross-team certification).

One ask from me: capture in the offer packet a post-hire 6mo success plan and an explicit leveling rubric for promotion to Staff — that reduces negotiation friction.

-Markus
Head of Inference Runtime
markus_klein@redwood.ai

From: alex_martinez@redwood.ai
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Candidate: Jordan Lee — initial leveling and comp ask

Folks —

Adding manager perspective: I interviewed Jordan on the system design and production readiness loops. Notes:
- He proposed a rollout strategy for model variants that reduces tail latency by ~18% in our simulation.
- Owned a cross-org migration to quantized kernels at GrowthAI that saved $1.2M/year.
- Strong stakeholder management with infra and platform teams.

Given the scope and the autonomy he demonstrated, I prefer L6. He will be the technical lead on the prefix caching initiative and will influence runtime kernel selection. No direct reports required for success.

If we move L6, I recommend: 
1) Offer base 240k, 25% target bonus, and 60k equity (Option B).
2) Add a promotion checkpoint at 9 months tied to delivering the prefix caching rollout and two cross-team integrations.
3) If Evelyn approves comp above midpoint, we proceed; otherwise present the elevated L5 / signaled promotion path.

Happy to jump on a quick call if you want to talk through sign-off language.

Alex Martinez
Director, Inference Platforms
alex_martinez@redwood.ai

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, alex_martinez@redwood.ai
Cc: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Bcc: offers@kepler.com
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Candidate: Jordan Lee — initial leveling and comp ask

Thanks for the quick responses — clear preference for L6 and the compensation package. Evelyn, can you confirm approval to extend Option B (base 240k / 25% bonus / 60k equity)? Per comp governance, this is roughly ~7% above L6 midpoint. I've attached the offer packet (offer_packet_JordanLee.pdf) and the comp comps spreadsheet.

If approved, I'll proceed with verbal and send the DocuSign once Jordan confirms verbal acceptance. Proposed sign-off box to include in the HR packet: 
- Title: Staff Engineer (L6)
- Manager: Alex Martinez
- Requisition: R-2026-413
- Offer: base $240,000; target bonus 25%; equity 60,000 RSU (4y)
- Promotion checkpoint: 9 months, criteria attached in the success plan doc (link above).

Jordan (external) — we have one small ask: can you confirm your target start window (April or May)? We also asked Kepler to hold offer until we confirm level.

Lauren Bishop
Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Attachments: offer_packet_JordanLee.pdf (offer packet stub), 20260218_offer_comps.xlsx (comps)
